part.text:
The image is ready. Here's a summary:

**Rendered:** `/work/SystemContext.svg` — the workspace defines exactly one view, the **System Context View: Library**, showing:
- **Patron** (person, teal) → **Library** (software system, blue), with the relationship *"Browses the catalogue through"* `[HTTPS]`
- C4-style colors, a title, and a legend

**Also saved:** `/work/SystemContext.puml` — the PlantUML source generated from the Structurizr export, in case you want a PNG later.

One caveat: this environment has no Java/Node/Python and no external network, so no PlantUML/Mermaid renderer was available — I generated the SVG directly from the exported view data (which is why it's SVG rather than PNG). If you run this on a machine with Java, `plantuml SystemContext.puml` will produce a PNG from the exact same definition.
